note: Device scenarios for tickets 73-75, run by ci/device/*.sh against a development build on a registered reference phone. They use only launch extras the automation runner already understands (LaunchOptions: forge_scenario, autoplay, autoplaySpeed, quitAfterAutoplay), so no client change is needed. Each bot match takes about 80 s of match-clock time. Video capture is OFF for every measured scenario (plan: separate capture condition).

scenarios.purpose: Fast correctness and cold frame-pacing smoke: three approved seeds at 8x match clock (every frame still rendered).
Steady-state frame pacing at the real match clock over the approved seeds plus two more; compared against the stored baseline per phone.
20-minute sustained run: sixteen consecutive bot matches at the real clock with every screen transition, for peak PSS, PSS trend (leaks), thermal status and crashes.
